# cargo-hosted (cargo hosted) at http://gateway.test/gw
# set ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN to a credential with access to this repository

## Cargo registry — .cargo/config.toml
[registries.cargo-hosted]
index = "sparse+http://gateway.test/gw/cargo/cargo-hosted/"
credential-provider = "cargo:token"

## sign in
printf '%s' "$ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN" | cargo login --registry cargo-hosted

## publish
cargo publish --registry cargo-hosted
